key: It's a vending machine.\nWhich drink would you like? \G
en: It's a vending machine.\nWhich drink would you like? \G
ja: 自動販売機だ。\nどの飲み物にする? \G

key: \GA Fresh Water dropped down!
en: \GA Fresh Water dropped down!
ja: \Gおいしいみずが出てきた!

key: \GBonus! Another Fresh Water dropped down.
en: \GBonus! Another Fresh Water dropped down.
ja: \Gボーナス! もう1本おいしいみずが出てきた。

key: \GYou have no room left in the bag.
en: \GYou have no room left in the bag.
ja: \Gバッグに空きがない。

key: \GYou don't have enough money.
en: \GYou don't have enough money.
ja: \Gお金が足りない。

key: \GA Soda Pop dropped down!
en: \GA Soda Pop dropped down!
ja: \Gサイコソーダが出てきた!

key: \GBonus! Another Soda Pop dropped down.
en: \GBonus! Another Soda Pop dropped down.
ja: \Gボーナス! もう1本サイコソーダが出てきた。

key: \GA Lemonade dropped down!
en: \GA Lemonade dropped down!
ja: \Gミックスオレが出てきた!

key: \GBonus! Another Lemonade dropped down.
en: \GBonus! Another Lemonade dropped down.
ja: \Gボーナス! もう1本ミックスオレが出てきた。

key: ???: Mm, you don't see many folks up here these days.
en: ???: Mm, you don't see many folks up here these days.
ja: ???: ふむ、最近はここらであまり人を見かけんな。

key: Not beside that gaggle of others that wouldn't even take the time of day to chat.
en: Not beside that gaggle of others that wouldn't even take the time of day to chat.
ja: 話す時間すら惜しむような連中の一団は別としてな。

key: You headin' into Victory Road?
en: You headin' into Victory Road?
ja: チャンピオンロードに向かうのか?

key: The name's Azer, and if you're willin', I got a job for you.
en: The name's Azer, and if you're willin', I got a job for you.
ja: 名はアゼル。その気があるなら、仕事を頼みたいんだが。

key: AZER: That's a good lad.
en: AZER: That's a good lad.
ja: アゼル: いい若者だ。

key: AZER: That's a good lass.
en: AZER: That's a good lass.
ja: アゼル: いい娘だ。

key: AZER: That's a good fellow.
en: AZER: That's a good fellow.
ja: アゼル: いい奴だ。

key: Now, you see, I've been contracted to go clean up that cave system what people call Victory Road.
en: Now, you see, I've been contracted to go clean up that cave system what people call Victory Road.
ja: 実はな、チャンピオンロードって呼ばれてるあの洞窟を掃除する仕事を請け負っててな。

key: But debris? Litter?
en: But debris? Litter?
ja: けど、がれきとか? ゴミとか?

key: Nah.
en: Nah.
ja: いや、違う。

key: My job is spirit-hunting.
en: My job is spirit-hunting.
ja: 俺の仕事は霊狩りだ。

key: That place has its share of ghosts in it.
en: That place has its share of ghosts in it.
ja: あそこにはそれなりに幽霊がいるんだよ。

key: They ain't exactly ghosts in the traditional sense...
en: They ain't exactly ghosts in the traditional sense...
ja: まあ、普通の意味での幽霊とはちょっと違うんだが…

key: More like after-images.
en: More like after-images.
ja: 残像みたいなもんだな。

key: Remnants of former Champions who once roamed those halls, whether decades ago or so recently you could pass them on the street.
en: Remnants of former Champions who once roamed those halls, whether decades ago or so recently you could pass them on the street.
ja: かつてあの通路を歩いていた歴代チャンピオンたちの名残さ。何十年も前の奴もいれば、道ですれ違ってもおかしくないくらい最近の奴もいる。

key: Who knows why it's happened-- beyond something or other of the crystals in there reflecting their presence and power as if it were light.
en: Who knows why it's happened-- beyond something or other of the crystals in there reflecting their presence and power as if it were light.
ja: なんでそうなるのかは知らんが、中の結晶がやつらの存在と力を、光みたいに反射してるとかなんとか。

key: Not too many places like that across the world, but I reckon I been to just about all of 'em.
en: Not too many places like that across the world, but I reckon I been to just about all of 'em.
ja: 世界中探してもそう多くはない場所だが、俺はほとんど全部回ったと思うぜ。

key: But see, this one's a unique problem.
en: But see, this one's a unique problem.
ja: だが、こいつは厄介な部類でな。

key: I'm used to the odd cave refracting passing travelers...
en: I'm used to the odd cave refracting passing travelers...
ja: 行き交う旅人を反射する変な洞窟には慣れてるんだが…

key: But a Victory Road? Former Champions?
en: But a Victory Road? Former Champions?
ja: チャンピオンロード? しかも歴代チャンピオンだと?

key: Forgive the pun, but it's just out of my league.
en: Forgive the pun, but it's just out of my league.
ja: しゃれのつもりはないが、俺の手には負えん。

key: The wild Pokémon are tough enough, but altogether it's a level I just can't compete on.
en: The wild Pokémon are tough enough, but altogether it's a level I just can't compete on.
ja: 野生ポケモンだけでも十分手強いのに、全体としちゃ俺じゃ太刀打ちできないレベルだ。

key: And that's why I need your help.
en: And that's why I need your help.
ja: だから、お前さんの力を借りたいのさ。

key: If you're strollin' on in there as confident as you seem to be, I'm willing to wager my work that you can deal with those guys.
en: If you're strollin' on in there as confident as you seem to be, I'm willing to wager my work that you can deal with those guys.
ja: その自信満々な様子であそこに乗り込むつもりなら、あいつらの相手ができるに賭けてもいい。

key: I've already done the part of stabilizing the spirits' presence...
en: I've already done the part of stabilizing the spirits' presence...
ja: 霊の存在を安定させる作業はもう済ませてある…

key: All you gotta do is find 'em, subdue 'em-- which'll usually mean a battle-- and then free 'em.
en: All you gotta do is find 'em, subdue 'em-- which'll usually mean a battle-- and then free 'em.
ja: あとはお前さんが見つけて、抑えて――たいていはバトルになるが――そして解放してやるだけだ。

key: You can handle that, right?
en: You can handle that, right?
ja: できるだろ?

key: AZER: Sensational.
en: AZER: Sensational.
ja: アゼル: 上出来だ。

key: I knew I had a good feeling about you the moment I saw you.
en: I knew I had a good feeling about you the moment I saw you.
ja: 一目見た時から、いい予感がしてたんだ。

key: Then take this.
en: Then take this.
ja: なら、これを受け取れ。

key: This machine will collect any excess spiritual residue in the area and store it in the crystal inside.
en: This machine will collect any excess spiritual residue in the area and store it in the crystal inside.
ja: この機械はあたり一帯の余剰な霊的な名残を集めて、中の結晶に貯めておく。

key: It'll give you a little nudge if there's any of them spirits in the room with you.
en: It'll give you a little nudge if there's any of them spirits in the room with you.
ja: 同じ部屋に霊がいれば、ちょっとした反応を返してくれる。

key: You can also use it to check how many spirits you've freed.
en: You can also use it to check how many spirits you've freed.
ja: 何体の霊を解放したかも、これで確認できるぞ。

key: AZER: By my counter, there should be about 25 total in Victory Road.
en: AZER: By my counter, there should be about 25 total in Victory Road.
ja: アゼル: 俺の計算じゃ、チャンピオンロード全体でだいたい25体はいるはずだ。

key: Also, some of them tend to distort the environment around them.
en: Also, some of them tend to distort the environment around them.
ja: それと、周りの環境をゆがめる霊もいるから気をつけろ。

key: That crystal energy can mimick the powers of any given place, so be ready for that.
en: That crystal energy can mimick the powers of any given place, so be ready for that.
ja: あの結晶のエネルギーはどんな場所の力でも真似できる。心の準備はしとけよ。

key: No easy task, is it?
en: No easy task, is it?
ja: 簡単な仕事じゃないだろ?

key: But I'll make sure to reward you handsomely should you finish.
en: But I'll make sure to reward you handsomely should you finish.
ja: だが終わらせたら、たっぷり礼はさせてもらうぜ。

key: Now set off, little one!
en: Now set off, little one!
ja: さあ、行ってこい、坊主!

key: Whether it's mine or not, there is work to be done!
en: Whether it's mine or not, there is work to be done!
ja: 俺の仕事だろうがなんだろうが、やるべきことがあるんだからな!

key: AZER: Ah?
en: AZER: Ah?
ja: アゼル: あ?

key: Truly a pity.
en: Truly a pity.
ja: 実に残念だ。

key: Here I thought I might've finally found the one who could help.
en: Here I thought I might've finally found the one who could help.
ja: ようやく手伝ってくれる奴を見つけたと思ったんだがな。

key: AZER: Too busy with your own problems too, huh?
en: AZER: Too busy with your own problems too, huh?
ja: アゼル: お前さんも自分のことで手一杯ってわけか。

key: But so is the world, little one.
en: But so is the world, little one.
ja: だが世の中みんなそうだ、坊主。

key: And how will anything get better that way?
en: And how will anything get better that way?
ja: それでどうやって何かが良くなるってんだ?

key: AZER: Mm?
en: AZER: Mm?
ja: アゼル: ん?

key: Don't suppose you decided to listen to little ol' me after all, did you?
en: Don't suppose you decided to listen to little ol' me after all, did you?
ja: 結局、このジジイの話を聞く気になったってわけか?

key: Remnants of former Champions who once romaned those halls, whether decades ago or so recently you could pass them on the street.
en: Remnants of former Champions who once romaned those halls, whether decades ago or so recently you could pass them on the street.
ja: かつてあの通路を歩いていた歴代チャンピオンたちの名残さ。何十年も前の奴もいれば、道ですれ違ってもおかしくないくらい最近の奴もいる。

key: I've already done the part of stablizing the spirits' presence...
en: I've already done the part of stablizing the spirits' presence...
ja: 霊の存在を安定させる作業はもう済ませてある…

key: AZER: Then what're you doin'?
en: AZER: Then what're you doin'?
ja: アゼル: なら、何してるんだ?

key: AZER: What're you doin'?
en: AZER: What're you doin'?
ja: アゼル: 何してるんだ?

key: You change your mind or something?
en: You change your mind or something?
ja: 気が変わったのか?

key: It's not so complicated.
en: It's not so complicated.
ja: そう難しい話じゃない。

key: All you gotta do is find the spirits in Victory Road, subdue 'em-- which'll usually mean a battle-- and then free 'em.
en: All you gotta do is find the spirits in Victory Road, subdue 'em-- which'll usually mean a battle-- and then free 'em.
ja: チャンピオンロードで霊を見つけて、抑えて――たいていはバトルになるが――そして解放するだけだ。

key: AZER: Come by every so often and I'll give you some stuff based on how you've done so far.
en: AZER: Come by every so often and I'll give you some stuff based on how you've done so far.
ja: アゼル: たまに顔を出せ、これまでの成果に応じて何かくれてやる。

key: There's 25 in total, so what do you say I pay out after every 5 spirits, huh?
en: There's 25 in total, so what do you say I pay out after every 5 spirits, huh?
ja: 全部で25体だ、5体倒すごとに払うってのはどうだ?

key: Now, let's see what you've got.
en: Now, let's see what you've got.
ja: さあ、成果を見せてもらおうか。

key: AZER: What've you got for me?
en: AZER: What've you got for me?
ja: アゼル: 何を持ってきた?

key: Based on your current count...
en: Based on your current count...
ja: 今の数からすると…

key: Hm.
en: Hm.
ja: ふむ。

key: Would you like to turn the EXP All on now?
en: Would you like to turn the EXP All on now?
ja: みんなのがくしゅうそうちを　今すぐ　ONに　しますか?

key: AZER: And that's that, ain't it.
en: AZER: And that's that, ain't it.
ja: アゼル: これで終わりってわけだな。

key: Well, fancy that.
en: Well, fancy that.
ja: いやはや、たいしたもんだ。

key: Knew I picked the right fellow for the job.
en: Knew I picked the right fellow for the job.
ja: やっぱり、仕事を頼む相手は間違ってなかった。

key: You've been a huge help, kiddo, but I won't keep you any longer.
en: You've been a huge help, kiddo, but I won't keep you any longer.
ja: 本当に助かったよ、坊主。もうこれ以上は引き止めない。

key: I'm sure someone like you has plenty else they're itchin' to get to.
en: I'm sure someone like you has plenty else they're itchin' to get to.
ja: お前さんみたいなのは、他にもやりたいことが山ほどあるだろうしな。

key: I'll take my time and mosey on to the next job whenever it comes.
en: I'll take my time and mosey on to the next job whenever it comes.
ja: 俺はのんびり、次の仕事が来るまで気ままにやるさ。

key: Good luck with your future too.
en: Good luck with your future too.
ja: お前さんもこれから頑張れよ。

key: AZER: There's not too much more I can do for you now.
en: AZER: There's not too much more I can do for you now.
ja: アゼル: もう俺にしてやれることはあんまりないな。

key: Good luck out there.
en: Good luck out there.
ja: 外じゃ　気をつけな

key: Remember, if you see the little blip when you enter the room, it means someone's there with you.
en: Remember, if you see the little blip when you enter the room, it means someone's there with you.
ja: 覚えとけ、部屋に入った時にちょっとした反応があったら、誰かがそこにいるってことだ。

key: AZER: I'll take my time and mosey on to the next job whenever it comes.
en: AZER: I'll take my time and mosey on to the next job whenever it comes.
ja: アゼル: 俺はのんびり、次の仕事が来るまで気ままにやるさ。

key: Oh, finally, some damn customers!
en: Oh, finally, some damn customers!
ja: おお、やっとお客さんか、ちくしょう!

key: Here I thought I was clever, setting up shop in this place where strong Trainers would pass by!
en: Here I thought I was clever, setting up shop in this place where strong Trainers would pass by!
ja: 強いトレーナーが通るこの場所に店を構えるなんて、我ながら賢いと思ってたのに!

key: I wasn't!
en: I wasn't!
ja: 全然賢くなかった!

key: If you feel bad for me, buy something!
en: If you feel bad for me, buy something!
ja: 同情するなら何か買ってってよ!

key: Fresh Water - $200
en: Fresh Water - $200
ja: おいしいみず - $200

key: Soda Pop - $300
en: Soda Pop - $300
ja: サイコソーダ - $300

key: Lemonade - $350
en: Lemonade - $350
ja: ミックスオレ - $350

key: Cancel
en: Cancel
ja: やめる

en: Yes
ja: はい

en: No
ja: いいえ
